literal: deceitful / he of the mind / deceitful / conduct / elements / all five / inside-indeed / will laugh
translation: The five elements within his own body will laugh inwardly at the hypocritical conduct of a man with a deceitful mind.
modern: வஞ்சகமான மனத்தை உடையவனின் பொய்யான ஒழுக்கத்தைக் கண்டு, அவனது உடம்பில் உள்ள ஐம்பூதங்களும் தமக்குள்ளே சிரிக்கும்.
explanation: This couplet exposes the folly of hypocrisy by pointing out that a person cannot hide their true nature from themselves. The 'five elements' (earth, water, fire, air, space) that make up the person's own body are constant witnesses to their deceit. Even if the world is fooled by their outward conduct, their own inner being will mock their false behavior. The word 'நகும்' (will laugh) powerfully personifies the elements, showing the absurdity of trying to fake virtue.
